batch.canonicalInput: little-endian uint32 in row-major order, two flags encoded 0 or 1

library.format: Mach-O 64-bit dynamically linked shared library arm64

method.batch: One call for the whole warmed, contiguous uint32 row-major input and reusable uint8 output. NumPy widens sums to uint64 and reuses scratch arrays. numpy-batch views the same interleaved rows. numpy-columnar-batch makes one contiguous transposed copy outside timing and reports the copy cost and storage. Division by row count gives per-account throughput.
method.memory: Fresh subprocess for each backend and round; process-lifetime peak RSS includes interpreter, imports, constructed inputs and warmed execution. Scratch is an explicit array-byte count.
method.ratio: Median, min and max of paired elapsed wall-time ratios for the same round.
method.scalar: One complete ERP Python call produces the full dictionary; the timed consumer counts acceptances. Canonical JSON of every full result is checked outside timing.
method.scope: Transfer latency and independent batch throughput; excludes database, RPC, UI, compile and cold-start time.
method.timing: One complete dataset warm-up before each sample. Each round rotates backend order. Wall and process CPU exclude startup, preparation and output verification. Corpus and outputs are reused across passes.
